title: Australia Awards Scholarships
provider: Australian Government (DFAT), managed by Australia Awards in Indonesia
fieldsOfStudy: decentralised governance and basic service delivery
GEDSI (gender equality, disability and social inclusion)
energy transition and climate and infrastructure partnership
languageRequirement: Required at application. Masters: IELTS 6.0 / TOEFL iBT 80 / TOEFL ITP 552 / PTE 56 (equity target groups: IELTS 4.5 / iBT 33 / ITP 425 / PTE 32). PhD: IELTS 6.5 / iBT 88 / ITP 570 / PTE 61 (Government of Indonesia and equity target groups: IELTS 6.0 / iBT 80 / ITP 552 / PTE 56)
description: Fully funded Masters or PhD study at an Australian university for Indonesian citizens. Covers return air travel, a one-off establishment allowance, full tuition fees and a contribution to living expenses.
requirements: Minimum GPA: Masters 2.9, PhD 3.0 (equity target groups 2.75 for both)
Online application form
Supporting documents listed in the Australia Awards Scholarships Policy Handbook
Targeted categories only: SK PNS, KTP from an equity-target province, or letter confirming disability status
notes: 2028 intake. Deadline 28 Apr 2027, 11:00 WIB. Must apply for a course in the priority fields of study (focus areas of the Australia-Indonesia Development Partnership Plan 2024-2028). Min GPA: Masters 2.9, PhD 3.0; equity target groups 2.75 (minGpa holds the lowest so the GPA filter never hides it from an eligible student). English test validity date differs between the General Requirements page (valid on 1 Jan 2027) and the Supporting Documents page (valid on 1 Jan 2028); confirm with AAI before stating it.
changeSummary: Corrected the English requirement (a score is required at application), added the priority fields of study, and added the GPA minimums for Masters, PhD and equity target groups.

title: LPDP-Australia Awards Scholarships
provider: LPDP (Government of Indonesia) and Australia Awards in Indonesia (Australian Government)
languageRequirement: IELTS 6.5 (no band below 6.0), TOEFL iBT 84 (no section below 21) or PTE Academic 58 (no skill below 50)
description: Masters scholarship at an Australian university, jointly offered by LPDP and Australia Awards for Indonesian citizens. Includes a stipend, Overseas Student Health Cover and English training before departure.
requirements: Maximum age 42 on 31 December of the application year
Single-degree, full-time Master's (24 months); choose 3 universities, no LoA needed to apply
Online application via LPDP

Documents: KTP, bachelor's certificate and transcript, degree equivalence and GPA conversion documents, English certificate, online recommendation letter, declaration, personal profile and commitment to return to Indonesia (a missing essential document means automatic rejection)
notes: 2027 intake, classes start February 2027. English scores from the LPDP-AAS General Requirements page. People with disability and residents of target areas are encouraged to apply. Co-funded by LPDP and Australia Awards: tuition is listed as an LPDP funding component, return airfare on the Australia Awards entitlement page. Closing time not published: the Australian Embassy and Australia Awards Indonesia only give the date (4 May 2026). No 2028-intake dates published for LPDP-AAS yet (the general Australia Awards round opens 1 Feb 2027 but does not name LPDP-AAS).
changeSummary: Added the age limit, TOEFL iBT and PTE scores, the document list, tuition and return airfare.

title: Fulbright Master's Degree Scholarship
provider: AMINEF (American Indonesian Exchange Foundation), funded by the U.S. Government
languageRequirement: TOEFL ITP 550, TOEFL iBT 80, IELTS 6.5 or Duolingo 125 (minimum varies by field)
description: One to two years of Master's study at a U.S. university for Indonesian S1 graduates. Grant of up to USD 52,000 per year for tuition, stipend and health cover, plus flights, visa and settling-in support.
requirements: Indonesian citizen with an S1 degree, GPA at least 3.0
Completed application form with one-page study objective, one-page personal statement and an academic writing sample
English test score less than two years old (TOEFL ITP, TOEFL iBT, IELTS or Duolingo)
Three reference letters from an employer or university lecturer
Legalized transcript and diploma, with English translation
Valid ID (KTP or passport)
Curriculum vitae
benefits: Fulbright health benefit (ASPE) and university health insurance
Round-trip international airfare to the U.S. and domestic travel in Indonesia
TOEFL iBT/GRE/GMAT and university application fees
notes: Deadline 15 Feb 2027, 23:59 WIB. Study starts in the fall term of the following year. All fields except medicine involving patient care or clinical contact. No financial support for dependants. Preference for applicants without recent substantial U.S. experience.
changeSummary: Added deadline time (23:59 WIB) from the official form.

title: Fulbright Doctoral Degree (PhD) Scholarship
provider: AMINEF (American Indonesian Exchange Foundation), funded by the U.S. Government
languageRequirement: TOEFL ITP 575, TOEFL iBT 90, IELTS 7.0 or Duolingo 135
description: Three years of PhD funding at a U.S. university for Indonesians with an S2 degree who intend to take up or return to an academic position. Grant of up to USD 50,000 per year plus travel and visa support.
requirements: Indonesian citizen with an S2 degree, GPA at least 3.0
Intention to take up or return to an academic position after the degree
Not currently pursuing another degree or holding another scholarship
Completed application form with study objective, personal statement and an academic writing sample
English test score less than two years old
Three reference letters from an employer or university lecturer
Legalized transcript and diploma, with English translation
Valid ID (KTP or passport) and curriculum vitae
benefits: Fulbright health benefit (ASPE) and university health insurance
Round-trip international airfare to the U.S. and domestic travel in Indonesia
Admission test and university application fees
notes: Deadline 15 Feb 2027, 23:59 WIB. Funding for three years. Not open to medicine involving patient care. No U.S. government exchange program in the previous three years. No financial support for dependants.
changeSummary: Added deadline time (23:59 WIB) from the official form.

title: Swedish Institute Scholarships for Global Professionals
languageRequirement: Set by each Swedish master's programme
description: Fully funded Master's study in Sweden for professionals with leadership experience from 34 countries, including Indonesia. Applicants must first apply to an eligible programme through University Admissions in Sweden.
requirements: Apply to an eligible Swedish master's programme via University Admissions by 15 January 2027 and pay the application fee
At least 3,000 hours of work experience before February 2027, from at most three employers
Demonstrated leadership experience
Be liable to pay tuition fees in Sweden
Be admitted to the programme on the first admissions day
Documents on SI templates: CV, proof of work and leadership experience, two reference letters; plus a passport or national ID copy and a motivation written in the portal
benefits: Full tuition fees, paid directly to the university
notes: 2027/28 intake. Two steps: university application 16 Oct 2026 – 15 Jan 2027, then SI scholarship portal 8–24 Feb 2027 (portal closes 14:59 CET on 24 Feb 2027). Eligible programmes list published 13 Nov 2026. Does not include insurance or family grants.
changeSummary: Added the eligible fields of study and the required documents.

title: Stipendium Hungaricum Scholarship
languageRequirement: Set by each Hungarian university; Hungarian-taught programmes need B2 Hungarian
description: Hungarian government scholarship for bachelor's, master's and doctoral study at Hungarian universities, for citizens of partner countries including Indonesia.
requirements: Online application at apply.stipendiumhungaricum.hu
Nomination by the Indonesian sending partner (may have an earlier internal deadline)
Only programmes supported by the Hungary-Indonesia cooperation agreement
Medical certificate on the official form (awardees only, presented at the compulsory medical examination in Hungary)
benefits: Free dormitory place or HUF 40,000 monthly housing contribution
Medical care under Hungarian law plus supplementary insurance up to HUF 65,000 per year
notes: 2026/27 round. Stipend, housing and insurance figures from the official About page (exchange rate of 13 Oct 2025). The 2027/28 call has not been published yet; previous deadlines were mid-January. Deadline time (15 Jan 2026, 2 p.m. Central European Time) and Indonesia's eligibility from the official 2026/27 Call for Applications.
changeSummary: Clarified that the medical certificate is only needed by awardees, at the medical examination in Hungary.

title: Japanese Government (MEXT) Scholarship – Research Students
provider: Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology (MEXT), Japan, via the Embassy of Japan in Indonesia
languageRequirement: TOEFL iBT 72, IELTS 5.5, TOEIC L&R 785, TOEIC S&W 310 or JLPT N2 (issued July 2024 or later; Duolingo, TOEFL Prediction and NAT-TEST/J-TEST not accepted)
description: Japanese government scholarship for graduate study or research at a Japanese university, through embassy recommendation. Covers tuition, a monthly allowance and airfare.
requirements: Born on or after 2 April 1992 (maximum age 34 on 1 April 2027)
D4, S1 or S2 graduate with a final GPA of at least 3.2
Field of study in the same discipline as the previous degree
English or Japanese certificate (TOEFL iBT, IELTS, TOEIC or JLPT) issued July 2024 or later
Online registration at daftar.beasiswamext.com, then documents posted in 3 sets to the Embassy of Japan in Jakarta
Application Form 2027 with a colour photo
Field of Study and Research Plan 2027 (maximum 2 pages)
Transcript and diploma of the last degree in English or Japanese, legalized by the university
Recommendation letter from the rector, dean, head of department or a lecturer (original signature)
Recommendation letter from employer (if employed)
Abstract of thesis or final project
Portfolio (art or design applicants only)
benefits: Tuition, admission and entrance exam fees exempted
Regional supplement of ¥2,000–3,000 per month in designated areas
notes: 2027 intake (April or September/October 2027). Registration 1–22 Apr 2026; documents had to arrive at the Embassy of Japan in Jakarta by 22 Apr 2026, 23:59 WIB. Selection: document screening, written test (English and Japanese), then interview in Jakarta. The 2028 round is not announced yet; based on past rounds it may open around April 2027.
changeSummary: Added free student visa processing to the benefits.

title: LPDP SHARE Scholarship (Social, Humanities, Art for People, Religious Studies, Education)
provider: LPDP (Lembaga Pengelola Dana Pendidikan), Ministry of Finance of Indonesia
languageRequirement: Overseas Master's: IELTS 6.5, TOEFL iBT 80, PTE Academic 58 or Duolingo 120. Overseas Doctoral: IELTS 7.0, TOEFL iBT 94, PTE Academic 65 or Duolingo 130 (general category; lower for affirmation categories; waived with unconditional LoA)
description: Indonesian government scholarship for Master's (up to 24 months) or Doctoral (up to 48 months) study in social, humanities, arts, religious and education fields, at home or abroad.
requirements: Minimum GPA: Master's 3.00, Doctoral 3.25 (general category)
Maximum age on 31 December: Master's 35, Doctoral 40 (general category)
English certificate valid within two years, unless holding an unconditional LoA
Domestic study: university accredited A/Unggul and in the QS World University Rankings top 1,200, programme accredited A/Unggul/Internasional (general and civil-servant categories)
Full or partial funding scheme (partial only for general and CPNS/PNS/TNI/POLRI applicants)
benefits: International seminar and journal publication funding
notes: 2026 batch 2. Final results 30 November 2026; earliest study start 1 January 2027. GPA, age and language rules differ for CPNS/PNS/TNI/POLRI, Papua, affirmation regions, low-income and disability categories. The 2027 batch 1 schedule is not out yet.
changeSummary: Added PTE and Duolingo scores, the partial funding scheme, the QS ranking rule for domestic study, and two missing benefits.

title: LPDP STEM Strategic Industries Scholarship
provider: LPDP (Lembaga Pengelola Dana Pendidikan), Ministry of Finance of Indonesia
languageRequirement: Overseas Master's: IELTS 6.5, TOEFL iBT 80, PTE Academic 58 or Duolingo 120. Overseas Doctoral: IELTS 7.0, TOEFL iBT 94, PTE Academic 65 or Duolingo 130 (general category; civil-servant doctoral applicants use the Master's scores; waived with unconditional LoA)
description: Indonesian government scholarship for Master's and Doctoral study in STEM fields for strategic industries, at home or abroad. LPDP reserves at least 80% of awards for STEM fields.
requirements: Minimum GPA: Master's 3.00, Doctoral 3.25 (full funding)
English certificate valid within two years, unless holding an unconditional LoA
Maximum age on 31 December: Master's 35, Doctoral 40 (general category)
Online application on the LPDP portal
Domestic study: university accredited A/Unggul and in the QS World University Rankings top 1,200, programme accredited A/Unggul/Internasional (general and civil-servant categories)
Full or partial funding scheme (partial only for general and CPNS/PNS/TNI/POLRI applicants)
benefits: International seminar and journal publication funding
notes: 2026 batch 2, same schedule as other LPDP programmes (results 30 November 2026). Covers the 8 strategic industries plus the supporting fields public policy, law, and business and economics. Entrepreneurship and creative industries have their own requirements (not checked). Benefits from the official funding components list (14 items).
changeSummary: Listed the 8 strategic industries and supporting fields, added Doctoral English scores, the age limit, the partial funding scheme and the full benefits list.

title: Chevening Scholarships
provider: UK Government (Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office)
description: Fully funded one-year master's degree at a UK university for future leaders with work experience.
requirements: At least two years (2,800 hours) of work experience after the undergraduate degree
Apply to three different eligible UK master's courses
Return to home country for at least two years after the scholarship
Unconditional offer from one of the three courses by 17:00 UK time on 8 July 2027
benefits: Monthly living allowance (rate depends on studying inside or outside London)
Up to £75 for TB testing if required
notes: 2027/28 round, now closed. Applications opened in August 2026 and closed in October 2026 at 11:00 UTC.
changeSummary: Added the time for the unconditional offer deadline.
